data.source: existing complete CC0 January 2013 natural-pilot archive; no new selection or labels
data.admission: Authenticate both externally pinned audits, all 53 original closure identities, summary and selected HCE weights. Parse only requested role from the same retained bytes. Mechanical hash checks of test bytes are not performance exposure.
data.recovery: Exact byte copies may be relocated by SHA-256; original audit paths/identities and closure digest remain unchanged. Missing raw evidence stops training.

comparators.expanded: previously selected 753 coefficients plus six pawn-attack terms, lambda 0.02; frozen, never refitted on NNUE roles

model.mapping: native a8=0; black perspective swaps colors and square XOR 56
model.output: side-to-move score in cp/400; multiply by 400 then convert to White POV
model.mopUp: explicit inference-only ablation using frozen HCE fixedCp; no retraining or new coefficients

training.implementation: NumPy 2.3.5 / SciPy 1.17.0, float64 sparse full-batch CPU; no PyTorch/GPU dependency
training.calibration: k=4.0 frozen from preceding shared-train HCE calibration; no NNUE-validation recalibration
training.optimizerBudgetExhaustion: retain final finite iterate as fixed-budget result; abnormal line search/nonfinite states disqualify seed; no score-based restart
training.repeatPolicy: one complete three-seed run; canonical run-start marker prevents renamed-output retries

quantization.outputScale: largest power of two <=4096 fitting all rounded output weights in signed int16
quantization.finalRounding: floor((integer numerator * 400 + denominator/2)/denominator), then White-POV sign
quantization.overflow: reject saturation and prove int32 accumulator / int64 output bound with <=32 pieces
quantization.scoreClamp: no empirical retuning; reject outputs beyond +/-10000 cp on consumed rows or authored fixtures

selection.seedRule: median quantized validation CE of all three seeds for each ablation; never select luckiest seed; all seeds must complete without abnormal failure
selection.variantRule: among eligible median-seed ablations choose lower quantized validation CE, tie within 1e-12 favors net-only
selection.noEligibleCandidate: stop, preserve all results, keep NNUE test unopened

test.exposureMarker: canonical experiment-input state keyed by contract, label summary and role, independent of selection filename
test.bootstrap: 2000 family-cluster resamples, row-weighted means, seed 1050915; upper two-sided 95% CE difference endpoint strictly below zero versus each comparator
test.failure: stop without retuning, larger data, H8, runtime integration or new matches

feasibility.totalSize: report actual parameter, metadata and portable reference bytes separately; 6180 excludes code and metadata. Production WASM delta remains unmeasured until #84 admits G3.
feasibility.timing: optional reference-only scalar timing on training/authored rows; not device or production-search timing

artifacts.publication: research checkpoints local/private; commit weight-free reports, contracts and code only
artifacts.licensing: CC0 source; preserve teacher provenance and generated-artifact release decision; no automatic MIT grant for labels/parameters
artifacts.scope: separate H4 hypothesis; does not change the frozen H64 production plan or claim an Elo/time gain
